paras: Tricheilostoma broadleyi is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is endemic to Ivory Coast.
The specific name, broadleyi, is in honor of herpetologist Donald G. Broadley.
T. broadleyi is found in south-central Ivory Coast at altitudes of 300–500 m (980–1,640 ft).
The preferred habitats of T. broadleyi are forest and savanna.
T. broadleyi is a small species. Maximum total length (including tail) is 11.5 cm (4.5 in).
